title: Observations
summary: Logging what you notice about yourself, next to what you ate and did.
description: Feelings, what the body did, urges, thoughts: the half of a day the numbers are usually kept for. With a time on them they can be compared with meals and sleep.

stories.as: someone who gets bloated some afternoons
stories.want: to log it when it happens
stories.soThat: I can see whether it follows what I ate

requirements.text: An observation is logged with a time and a category.
Categories are a list the user owns and can add to; a new install starts with three.
A new category's emoji is chosen by the model; without one, 💭 is shown.
Category names match regardless of case and spacing.
